title: ARMS & GENTLE CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY KINDNESS. SOFT ARMS. EASY CORE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Friday is soft arms and a gentle core — a small break from the desk, nothing fierce. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft arms, a kind core, and you showed up. Enjoy your Friday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH UPS
exercises.cue: Stand facing a wall, feet a comfortable step back, hands on the wall at about shoulder height. Soft belly. Bend the elbows and bring the chest gently toward the wall, then press away with control. Soft neck, easy breath. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push ups. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, hands on the wall, bend the elbows and bring the chest gently in, then press away. Smaller range is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the arms. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Wall push ups done. Well done.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Start with hands near the shoulders, then press gently upward only as high as feels kind. Soft neck, easy breath. Smaller press is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, hands near the shoulders, press gently upward only as high as feels kind. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Reach the arms forward softly, then draw the elbows back as if squeezing a soft cushion between the shoulder blades. Soft neck, chest open. Smaller squeeze is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, reach forward softly, then draw the elbows back and open the chest. Soft neck. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the upper back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly — this is your gentle core. Lift one knee a little toward the ceiling, then set it down gently. Alternate sides with an easy rhythm. Soft hands on the seat edges if you like. Smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts for a soft core. Two sets of eight each leg. Soft belly, lift one knee a little, set it down gently. Easy rhythm. Smaller lift is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the hips. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. That's the session — lovely work.
